【原视频简介】
Download Tutti VM: https://tutti.sh/?bd7

Every time I moved a coding task between Codex, Claude Code, and a teammate, I became the API—copying prompts, files, and context by hand. In this video I test Tutti · VM on a real Scripti task: Codex makes a UI change, Claude Code reviews it with the earlier task attached, and Joanna and I continue the work through a permissioned Room with shared tasks and live previews. The result isn’t a fully autonomous AI team; we still choose the tasks, control access, and make the decisions. What Tutti changes is the handoff: the working state stays available instead of being rebuilt from scratch. This was recorded during Tutti · VM’s creator preview, so check the tracked link for current access and platform availability.

What you'll learn:
— How a real Scripti task moves from Codex implementation to Claude Code review
— How one Room keeps conversations, tasks, files, and live previews around a project
— How existing task context can be attached to the next agent session
— How teammates can use explicitly shared agents without exposing everything by default
— Where human direction, permissions, and final judgment still matter
